propositions: Commit bodies on main inconsistently wrap between 72-79 and 129-286 columns; a local 50/72 enforcer is needed at commit-msg stage to reject non-conforming messages before they land.

A commit-message-wrap hook must detect and name all lines exceeding 50 chars (subject) or 72 chars (body), while exempting trailers, TAG= lines, fenced blocks, indented literals, table rows, and lines dominated by unsplittable tokens (URLs, paths, identifiers).
Gerrit's commit-msg hook (which stamps Change-Id) must not be clobbered; pre-commit's migration mode must preserve it as commit-msg.legacy and chain both hooks without losing the Change-Id trailer.
The checker is check-only (never mutates the message) and is bypassable via git commit --no-verify; it runs locally at operator choice, not in CI.
make hooks must verify both pre-commit and commit-msg hook files are installed, warn if Change-Id stamping is missing, and exit non-zero if either hook file is absent.
